items.source: Translate the given HttpServletRequest into a view name.
request - the incoming HttpServletRequest providing the context from which a view name is to be resolved
items.translation: request - 提供用于解析视图名称上下文的传入 HttpServletRequest

items.source: Exception - if view name translation fails
items.translation: Exception - 如果视图名称翻译失败

items.source: the view name, or null if no default found
items.translation: 视图名称，或者如果未找到默认值则为null。

items.source: Strategy interface for translating an incoming HttpServletRequest into a logical view name when no view name is explicitly supplied.
items.translation: 用于在未显式提供视图名称时，将传入的 HttpServletRequest 转换为逻辑视图名称的翻译策略接口。
